chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, who said:
I said to Abī 'Abdillāh عليه السلام: I doubt while I am in sajdah, and I do not know whether I performed ruku' or not. So he said: You have performed ruku'; continue.

key_terms.امْضِ: continue and proceed with the prayer
key_terms.سَاجِدٌ: being in the state of sajdah during salat (prayer)
key_terms.فَلَا أَدْرِي: I do not know or am uncertain

ai.seo_question: What should I do if I doubt in sajdah whether I performed ruku' in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about doubt during salat (prayer) after one has moved into sajdah. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that such a person should treat the ruku' as having been performed and continue the prayer.
